name: jackpotkeywords-mcp-server
description: MCP server for JackpotKeywords — AI keyword research, SEO audits, and AI-visibility (AEO) scanning. Five tools: keyword recommendations (standard and deep), SEO audit, AEO scan via Gemini grounded search, and credit balance.
long_description:
MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for [JackpotKeywords](https://jackpotkeywords.web.app), an AI-powered keyword research, SEO audit, and AI-visibility scanning service.

Lets Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, and any other MCP-compatible client run keyword research, SEO audits, and answer-engine-optimization (AEO) scans directly from a chat prompt.

## Tools (5)

- **jackpotkeywords_recommend** — full keyword pipeline for a product URL or description. Returns up to 200 recommendations ranked by composite Jackpot Score (real Google Ads volume/CPC/competition + AI relevance). $0.10/call.
- **jackpotkeywords_recommend_deep** — same inputs as recommend, plus parallel competitor discovery and cluster/category/competitor-brand aggregates in the response. Built for agencies and consultants. $0.30/call.
- **jackpotkeywords_audit** — SEO audit on a URL. Crawls primary + secondary pages, scores across technical/content/crawlability/structured-data/local/social-sharing, returns keyword gaps and prioritized recommendations. AEO sold separately. $0.50/audit.
- **jackpotkeywords_aeo_scan** — fires 10 buyer-intent queries through Gemini's grounded search and reports per-query whether your URL was cited, mentioned, or absent. $1.00/scan.
- **jackpotkeywords_credit_balance** — free balance check.

Get your API key at https://jackpotkeywords.web.app/developers (self-serve, $2 starter credit, no card required).

JACKPOTKEYWORDS_API_BASE.title: API Base URL (optional)
JACKPOTKEYWORDS_API_BASE.description: Override the API base URL. Default: https://jackpotkeywords.web.app/api/v1

tools.name: jackpotkeywords_credit_balance
tools.description: Return the current JackpotKeywords credit balance for the authenticated account. Use this before calling paid tools to verify the account has credits available.

tools.name: jackpotkeywords_recommend
tools.description: Run the full keyword research pipeline for a product and return ranked keyword recommendations by composite Jackpot Score (volume, CPC, competition, trend, cluster strength, AI relevance). Backed by real Google Ads Keyword Planner data. Costs $0.10 per call (10 cents, regardless of limit). Refunded automatically on pipeline failure. Latency ~60-180 seconds.

tools.name: jackpotkeywords_recommend_deep
tools.description: Run the deep keyword research pipeline. Same inputs as jackpotkeywords_recommend, plus parallel competitor discovery (broadens the keyword set) and returns cluster + category + competitor-brand aggregates. Use when you need to see WHICH keyword clusters matter and WHO else is ranking, in one call. Costs $0.30 per call (30 cents, regardless of limit). Refunded automatically on pipeline failure. Latency ~75-200 seconds.

tools.name: jackpotkeywords_audit
tools.description: Run an SEO audit on a URL. Crawls primary + up to 8 secondary pages, checks technical/content/crawlability/structured-data/local/social-sharing categories, returns scored checks, per-page issues, keyword gaps, and prioritized recommendations. AEO data is NOT bundled (use jackpotkeywords_aeo_scan for that). Costs $0.50 per audit (50 cents). Refunded on failure. Latency ~20-60 seconds.

tools.name: jackpotkeywords_aeo_scan
tools.description: Run an AI-visibility scan for a product URL. Asks 10 buyer-intent queries against Gemini grounded search and reports, per query: whether the URL was cited as a source, mentioned in the answer text, or absent - plus the top sources the AI did cite. Costs $1.00 per scan (100 cents). Refunded automatically on failure. Latency ~30-120 seconds.
